title: A zone's NPC conditions and instances: res/paperwhite2/overworld/<zone>.json
description: Paper White 2's spawn data for a zone's NPCs (res/field/events/<zone>.json, by their ids): a condition under which an NPC appears, and an NPC's instances, the NPCs its record can be, one of which the field writes into it at zone entry (Spawns_OnZoneInit, src/paperwhite2/ov012/paperwhite2_spawns.c). The file is named after the zone. tools/paperwhite2/overworld.py packs the files into a member after the events' archive's own (a/1/2/6). docs/paperwhite2/plugins.md, NPC spawns.

npcs.description: The zone's NPCs that have a condition or instances

id.description: The NPC's id in the zone's events

when.description: When it appears: without it it always does. A chance holds all day (the day's seed), so leaving and coming back doesn't roll it again

instances.description: What the NPC can be: at zone entry the field picks one whose condition holds and whose flag isn't set, by weight from the day's seed, and writes it into the NPC's record; with none, the NPC doesn't appear. The record in the events is the host, and its own fields are unused

when.description: When it can be picked; without it, always

weight.description: Its share of the picks among the instances whose conditions hold; 1 by default

npc.description: The NPC it is, every field of an events record; its id is the host's
